categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Touches src/test/util/mining.{cpp,h} to update shared unit test block creation helpers.
categories.rationale: Fixes mining test utilities so that templates built on arbitrary parents recalculate subsidies, difficulty, and script padding rather than inheriting the active tip's values. As the PR notes, 'Existing reorg tests can underpay without failing, while a fork crossing a halving can overpay and fail with bad-cb-amount'.
